maya_sales: Heads-up: Prospect 'HelioSys' POC blocked. Their IdP rotated certs and SAML started failing; SCIM calls are rate-limited. They need a safe fallback for onboarding so trial users can continue.

tom_se: Error seen: SAML invalid_audience + SCIM 429s. Short-term: enable email-invite flow (viewer role only) + local retries for SCIM with backoff. No admin creation via fallback.

anya_sec: Security requirements: invites must be single-use, signed, TTL <=24h, and default role viewer. Logs must redact emails and store hashed identifiers. For Hosted invites Legal wants a DPA addendum.

ben_ops: Implementation plan: feature flag "sso_invite_fallback" -> show invite CTA on SAML validation failure, POST /v1/tenants/:t/invite with role=viewer, enqueue worker with exponential backoff (2s base, 4 retries). For Dedicated, provide a script that generates locally signed invites.

maya_sales: Pricing ask: will retries/invites be charged? Tom: waive first 500 invites for POC, extra counts toward invites metering; need finance/legal signoff.

anya_sec: Legal OK to waive for trial with written approval; require encrypted logs 90d and KMS-backed signing (customer KMS for Dedicated).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Feature rollout sso_invite_fallback -> canary 5% ci/8899

maya_sales: Owners: tom -> runbook + SE snippet; ben -> flag + dedicated script; anya -> loop Legal. ETA 24h.

(Notes: include runbook snippet in follow-up, legal thread to track DPA waiver)
